name: daisyUI
summary: Free, open-source component library that adds semantic UI component classes to Tailwind CSS.
description: daisyUI 5 provides 68 Tailwind CSS components — accordion, alert, avatar, badge, button, card, carousel, drawer, dropdown, modal, navbar, table, tabs and more — as semantic class names you drop into your markup. It installs as a Tailwind plugin (also usable from a CDN) and is framework agnostic, with themes, a theme generator, templates, a Figma library, charts and MCP offerings on daisyui.com.
contains: 68 Tailwind CSS components with copy-ready markup
Semantic class names (btn, card, navbar, modal …) styled by a Tailwind plugin
Component docs with examples for every component
Themes, a theme generator and templates on daisyui.com
Framework agnostic: plain HTML, React, Vue or any stack
